Latest review update (2026-09-27, #6182 head `6efffc9e82cd182dced78f6e136627c1a9902f66`): the contributor added the requested aggregate guard. Review exposed that `github.base_ref` is unavailable for `pull_request_review`; I confirmed the finding against GitHub documentation, corrected my earlier recommendation, and [replied with the five-job fix](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6182#discussion_r4117324686). Both the current workflow and a local candidate using `github.event.pull_request.base.ref` pass actionlint v1.7.7. Execution update (23:11 UTC): [Build + Test v3, attempt 2](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/actions/runs/36355491444/attempts/2) has completed successfully for head `6efffc9e82cd182dced78f6e136627c1a9902f66`: **36/36 jobs passed**, including JS, all three Go platforms, all 24 template builds, all six macOS API variants, cleanup, and the aggregate. I checked the [aggregate log](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/actions/runs/36355491444/job/108728180356): its four dependency results are all `success`, not `skipped`. The six macOS logs also confirm actual `go test -tags "$BUILD_TAGS" ./pkg/application -count=1` execution. This verifies the pull-request event path. Review-event runs remain `action_required`; the five-guard review-event correction is still unpublished, so this issue stays open pending that correction and landing. These results cover the PR's published head, not the unpublished #6167 changes. #6182 continues to own this repair; no duplicate branch was published.

Tracking update (2026-09-27): @TastyHeadphones has opened #6182 for this repair. I verified that its workflow at `57372cb43390a2471f8ee07ab953a33b3d8e47d6` is semantically identical to the unpublished local fix and that actionlint v1.7.7 passes. #6182 now supersedes the local CI publication plan; `codex/ga-ci-6145` is preserved at `83d29370127e6b3d868857c2a5c8736f384b2f96` and will not be published as a duplicate. Further GA synchronization will focus on #6167 while this contributor PR owns the CI repair.

I confirmed and explained the remaining aggregate-result guard feedback on #6182: `build_results` needs the master condition alongside `always()` so a non-master review cannot receive a passing aggregate from entirely skipped test jobs. The current v3 run is `action_required` with no jobs executed, so GitHub execution and native validation remain outstanding. The local preparation notes below are historical and no longer a request to publish another CI PR.

Prepared the workflow repair locally as `d8ecf65e3` on `codex/ga-ci-6145`, based on master `f5457ed12`.

It removes both syntax errors: the duplicate top-level permissions mapping and the unsupported `pull_request_review.branches` filter. The existing job conditions preserve the master-only behavior.

`actionlint v1.7.7` passes, `git diff --check` passes, and CodeRabbit completed with no findings. The commit is not pushed yet, pending manual confirmation required by this repository. GitHub execution of the corrected workflow and current-head native validation remain outstanding, so this issue remains open.


Latest local synchronization: Local commit 83d29370127e6b3d868857c2a5c8736f384b2f96 includes master b0b6c447781b804f3e794c150580e5c6588e6046. Master b0b6c4477 changes only contributors.svg: the displayed commit count changes from 5,911 to 5,909, and the contributor entry diorodrigus becomes erodrigus with the same avatar and credit, shifting the intervening cards. XML comparison confirms unchanged structure and layout attributes; all changed embedded images decode correctly. Each local merge contains exactly the upstream SVG change, passes diff checks, and leaves a clean worktree. The required coderabbit --plain command was attempted on each branch but is unsupported; the supported review reported no files to review for this SVG-only change. Ripwire reports zero structural regressions for the merge delta. Earlier beta.26 version/docs checks and source validation remain applicable. These merges are committed as taliesin-ai; nothing has been pushed. The CI repair is unchanged. Publishing its PR and verifying that GitHub starts the v3 jobs remain outstanding. Inherited recovery follow-ups are tracked in #6167 and #6168. Explicit manual push confirmation remains pending.
I'll take a look at this.

Hi there! Could you share your full Wails version, operating system, and a small example that reproduces the problem? It would also help to know what you expected to happen and what happened instead. Thanks!
